claims.exact_statement: For the local relative-phase unitary U_phi=exp(-i phi (n_a-n_b)/2), the input (|2,0>+|0,2>)/sqrt(2), and equal independent vacuum pure loss eta in both arms, the output quantum Fisher information is exactly 4 eta^2.
assumptions: local phase estimation within a single fringe
equal phase-independent vacuum pure loss in both arms
no phase diffusion, dark counts, thermal background, or mode mismatch
loss is traced to an inaccessible environment
claims.status: internally_reconstructed_exact_model_calculation; established literature context; no experimental validation
claims.novelty_boundary: The lossy-interferometry model and quantum Fisher information framework are established; this is a direct N=2 specialization, not a novelty claim.

claims.exact_statement: For any multimode optical probe with a positive Glauber-Sudarshan P measure, arbitrary classical correlations of coherent amplitudes, total mean signal energy N_in, and arbitrary joint output POVM, QFI for the same phase channel is at most eta N_in; with N_in=2m this is at most 2m eta.
assumptions: positive-P defines the classical probe class
phase encoding is exp(-i phi J_z) with J_z=(n_a-n_b)/2
claims.status: internally_reconstructed_bound from coherent-state QFI and QFI convexity
claims.novelty_boundary: Standard shot-noise/classical benchmark in the stated two-mode phase model; no novelty or universal benchmark beyond positive-P probes is claimed.
